title: No linked regression coverage for OCR resolve-text route
reasoning: The route performs image resolution, OCR execution, resolver error translation, ranked-match lookup, and an internal 500 fallback when the resolved point cannot be mapped back to a candidate, but the feature metadata includes no tests for this entrypoint. Without focused coverage, regressions in success payload shape, threshold handling, resolver exception mapping, or the 500 fallback could ship unnoticed.
recommendation: Add focused route tests for a successful resolve-text response, resolver failure translation, and the no-matching-candidate fallback.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The provided feature metadata lists no linked tests, and no test files were included as evidence for this route.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a pytest FastAPI route test that mocks resolve_image_source, run_ocr, OcrCoordinateResolver.resolve, and rank_ocr_matches to assert the response match on success, then separate cases for resolver failure and a resolved coordinate that does not map back to any ranked candidate.
minimumFixScope: Tests only for POST /api/sdk/ocr/resolve-text and its local error branches.
